verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, the Events API, an interactive API reference with code samples, public OpenAPI schemas and an MCP server. None of it names an official client SDK or library that PagerDuty publishes. OpenAPI schemas and raw APIs are building blocks a developer could use to generate or hand-write a client, and the MCP server belongs to a different story, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
